reports.title: APi Group Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Raises Full-Year 2026 Outlook

guidance.heading: Guidance
section: APi is raising its full-year 2026 guidance for net revenues and adjusted EBITDA.
• Net revenues of $9,200 to $9,250 million, up from the guidance provided on July 30, 2026 of $8,875 to $9,025 million
• Adjusted EBITDA of $1,235 to $1,255 million, up from the guidance provided on July 30, 2026 of $1,205 to $1,245 million
• Adjusted free cash flow conversion of 110%, based on adjusted net income
